prior_study_species_screen.study_unit: studyID×species where >=10 individuals have >=2 UTC days each with >=20 segment-derived fixes
prior_study_species_screen.source_caution: The 16 candidates include 2 External/NA study-id panels and possible parent study overlaps; these are NOT 16 independent ecological tests.

external_context_fields.flight_definition: preclassified commuting flight segments; no additional speed threshold
external_context_fields.extraction_rule: Read RDS container and export only these source metadata columns to gzip TSV; do not inspect any numeric height values at this stage.

fixed_source_preprocessing.date_utc: parse source timestamp in UTC, yyyy-mm-dd, year 2007-2024
fixed_source_preprocessing.coords: WGS84 degrees valid finite lat<=85 in absolute value
fixed_source_preprocessing.project: EPSG6933 WGS84 NSIDC equal-area for all taxa
fixed_source_preprocessing.time_thinning: earliest GPS fix per source study/species/animal/UTC calendar day/5-minute bin; no native altitude availability involved
fixed_source_preprocessing.source_quality: only source commuting-flight points present in this RDS; no interpolated or invented flight observations
fixed_source_preprocessing.source_inclusion: individual ID, source species, study ID/name, date, lon, lat, segment ID all required; null/NA source study ID uses source study name but flagged unresolved.

climate_opportunity_feasibility.environment: thermal_uplift and orographic_uplift are independent ERA5/topography annotations, not bird GPS vertical position measurements
climate_opportunity_feasibility.native_classification: Compute each bird-day median thermal_uplift from selected GPS fixes, then rank by calendar month within study×species among all bird-days with >=20 fixes. Low/high group boundaries are 25th and 75th percentiles. Track IDs are not dropped based on height.
climate_opportunity_feasibility.requirements: For primary environmental contrast, >=10 biological individuals each with at least 2 low and 2 high thermal-uplift bird-days that satisfy shared horizontal cell own-other-date >=10 fixes and enough other-bird reference; this is a stricter condition than the basic 2-day identity feasibility and is separately reported.
climate_opportunity_feasibility.sensor_limit: Point-wise ERA5 thermal uplift depends on location selected by bird and does not prove thermal utilized; conditional environment patterns are observational.

prior_parent_studies_to_deduplicate.21231406: Broader LifeTrack white stork SWGermany 2014-2017 study, likely overlaps Flack 2014
prior_parent_studies_to_deduplicate.manual_rule: Any such parent (if present) must be flagged as already examined/not independent, never counted as new species-study replication. Also check likely reexports from original other study IDs and duplicate tag/time identities after full source crosswalk.

target_decision.admit_for_new_numeric_height_analysis: Only after point x-y time and environmental availability are reported and source-level prior-overlap exclusion is fixed.
target_decision.species_universe: 38 taxa is source universe; bats not guaranteed eligible. All structurally unavailable taxa remain denominator.
target_decision.known_source_original_analysis: Authors modeled flight flapping and cost of transport, including individual repeatability of flap/eCOT, not conditional altitude distribution identity.
target_decision.do_not_infer: No causal wind response, adaptive foraging niche, vertical segregation, central-place mechanism, or cross-taxon law from structural eligibility.
